what: Three units of the blind description test with 8 of their 20 test snippets each, for the page tools/finding_neurons_you_can_describe.py.

source.snippets_and_key: test_items.json and test_key.json of analysis/describe_test.py prep (seed 0) on job sameraslan-1114-154532-cdc8; not committed

sampling: Per unit, random.Random(f'{seed}:{key}') samples 4 of the 10 firing snippet ids (sorted) and then 4 of the 10 random-position ids (sorted). The 8 are listed by id, which is the shuffled order of the test itself.
trimming: Whitespace runs become one space; kept are the last 7 words before the marked token and the first 5 after it; '…' marks a cut. The marked token is between << and >>, as in test_items.json.
